snippet.title: amFM | Wishlist Now | CRTime
snippet.description:
A dimension-hopping & contraption-building surreal RPG. Switch dimensions at any time and build elaborate mechanisms to destroy your foes in creative ways. Adapt your machines to withstand the protests of your unwilling test subjects. Please clean up this unmaterial broth of pain and suffering, now at home within CRITICAL REFLEX's fold. Coming soon to PC and XBOX Series X|S.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2984460/amFM/
